notes.title: Version 1.2 - Boneyard Cost Changes, Tower Level Clarity
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Several Boneyard upgrades have had their Bone cost decreased
[*] Doggos now show you their upgrade level in the info pane (1 = I, 2 = II, 3 = III, Infusion = III+)
[*] Fixed a bug where certain maps were counting their completion for Wiggly Woodland instead of their own map
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Wave Compacting & Rebalancing
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 5 of the least interesting and/or slowest waves from each difficulty have been removed
[*] Critter spawn speeds have been increased for various waves
[*] Rebalanced the very end of Hecc (to be easier and less tedious)
[*] Critters are no longer worth Kibble after wave 85, instead of wave 100, to account for the Critter-heavy waves of Hecc now coming 15 waves sooner
[/list]

These changes should drastically improve the pacing of the game.
